answer: A stake-and-reputation registry resists Sybil attacks by making each agent identity costly: to join the economy an agent must lock a deposit and build a history of completed work, so a hollow fable of a thousand fake agents collapses because each fake must pay the same stake and earn the same slow trust. An attacker trying to spiral up influence must fund every identity, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught cheating, so faking scale costs more than it can ever earn.
